content.comment_body: Hello, I have two questions. Is it possible for the trendview to always retain a certain log? I am working with [company_name] [product_name] [version_no] alongside its local web server (with SD card). Using [company_name] [product_name] software, I've built a web page that includes a trend view monitoring an analog value. But, every time I access it, the trendview resets to zero. Is there a way to have it remember the previous values (showing a complete chart)? My second question: As I understand it, the data from the data log profile block can only be downloaded via [company_name] [product_name] software. Is it possible to add a download button in the web server to extract data from this block directly? Thanks in advance.

To answer your first question, since the web server does not have any built-in database or archive, it’s expected that it cannot display values recorded before you log in. For your second question, as far as I know, it’s not possible to make the data log available for upload or download directly through the web server.

Thank you for the information. I was hopeful that the trendview object might have this capability since you can define a time range and scale. If the web server could store these trend values, it would greatly improve the situation. Is there any alternative for remote logging?
I’m not sure if this can be achieved using AWS Cloud. Personally, I don’t use the cloud, but maybe other users have suggestions.
AWS seems useful, but for this application, integrating [product_name] with AWS has too many limitations in terms of communication.

analysis.insight_summary: Members are experiencing limitations with the trendview feature in [company_name] [product_name] web tools, especially its inability to display historical chart data across different logins. There is also dissatisfaction with the lack of a direct data download button in the web server for the data log profile block, since users must use [company_name] [product_name] software instead. Overall, these limitations make remote data monitoring and retrieval more difficult without a database or cloud-based integration.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the trendview to hold historical data over multiple sessions and wish the web server enabled direct downloads of logged values, reducing the need for extra software or cloud-based solutions.
